literal_gloss: I-read the Acts of-the fourth council, the-one at Chalcedon, in books several. Fifteen sessions came-to-be, in which Dioscorus and Eutyches were-condemned, Nestorius was-excommunicated; Flavian after death innocent was-shown with Eusebius the-one of-Dorylaeum, Theodoret and Ibas. Other-things also were-examined, and piety was-strengthened.
lemmas: Πράξεις τῆς τετάρτης συνόδου (Acts of the Fourth Council)
τῆς ἐν Χαλκηδόνι (the one at Chalcedon)
Διόσκορος καὶ Εὐτυχὴς κατεκρίθησαν (Dioscorus and Eutyches were condemned)
Φλαβιανὸς μετὰ θάνατον ἀθῷος (Flavian after death innocent)
Ἄλλα ἐζητήθη, ἡ εὐσέβεια ἐκραταιώθη (other things examined, piety strengthened)
